correctness.rationale: The three distinct Laplacian eigenvalues of triangular J(n,2) yield a unique quadratic interpolation of the Radau IIA rational filter. Independent exact-rational matrix identities validate the explicit diagonal/edge/nonedge formulas. Positivity of Q4/Q5 is proved by explicit polynomial certificates; for n>=6 a negative rational witness plus Descartes gives precisely two positive diagonal roots. E74 has a strictly negative exact cubic discriminant and hence is positive on the positive axis; monotonicity of E_n(z/n) in n extends this to all n<=74; E_n(1/5)<0 for every n>=75 and Descartes gives two simple positive roots. H_n>0 for h>0. The verifier replayed 3770 exact checks including 25 full matrix identities; finite checks do not stand in for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The two independent sharp graph-size barriers for endpoint positivity are natural structural invariants of third-order implicit heat diffusion on the infinite triangular graph family. The result locates all sign-loss and sign-recovery timestep intervals with explicit low-degree polynomial equations, and proves the unexpected all-step strict positivity of every nonadjacent entry. Neither arbitrary parameter slicing nor textbook numerical evaluation: the paired thresholds require an all-n root-count and monotonicity argument.
